--[[ RNG CONFIG — the only place you need to edit to add shovels.
	Chance  = the "1 in N" odds (bigger = rarer)          (PLACEHOLDERS for now)
	Rarity  = key into Config.Rarities (card/tint color)  (PLACEHOLDERS for now)
	Power   = (optional) damage per hit; if missing it comes from Balance.ShovelPower(Chance)
	ImageId = "rbxassetid://..." IMAGE id (not decal id) used in the reel, index and inventory
	3D model = a Model with the same name in ReplicatedStorage > ShovelModels (falls back to a placeholder model)
]]

Config.MaxEquipped = 2     -- shovels spinning around a player at once
Config.RollCooldown = 2.4  -- seconds, enforced by the server
Config.BigRollAt = 100000    -- items with Chance >= this get the camera punch when rolled

-- rarity tiers in order, and the odds where each tier starts
Config.RarityOrder = {"Common", "Uncommon", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary", "Mythic", "Secret", "Divine"}
Config.RarityMinChance = {Common = 0, Uncommon = 100, Rare = 1000, Epic = 10000, Legendary = 100000, Mythic = 1000000, Secret = 100000000, Divine = 10000000000}

-- RARE DROP CUTSCENE
-- plays when (odds / player's luck) >= Threshold, so it scales with luck.
-- Sounds: paste any Roblox audio id ("rbxassetid://123") to replace these.
Config.RareDrop = {
	Threshold = 1000,
	Sounds = {
		Start  = {Id = "rbxassetid://77820131187937",  Volume = 1.5},  -- screen cuts to black
		Steps  = {                                                   -- one per rarity step of the climb
			Rare      = {Id = "rbxassetid://102456460734361", Volume = 1.5},
			Epic      = {Id = "rbxassetid://112301259896345", Volume = 1.5},
			Legendary = {Id = "rbxassetid://85230589033767",  Volume = 1.5},
			Mythic    = {Id = "rbxassetid://108417005528759", Volume = 1.5},
			Secret    = {Id = "rbxassetid://118553089210873", Volume = 1.5},
			Divine    = {Id = "rbxassetid://118553089210873", Volume = 1.8},
		},
		Reveal = {Id = "rbxassetid://125078105193243", Volume = 1.8},  -- white flash + shovel appears
		End    = {Id = "rbxassetid://126698655007674", Volume = 1.3},  -- cutscene fades out
	},
}

-- lookup helper
Config.ByName = {}
for _, item in ipairs(Config.Items) do Config.ByName[item.Name] = item end

-- 2026-10-03 (Claude, pacing test): normal shovels are 1.4x bigger (look and dig reach). A Giant keeps its old size 2, so it
-- digs ~1.8x the area of a normal shovel instead of ~3x (measured: Giant Tin 3.07 vs Tin 0.87 Snow/s before this change).
Config.BaseSize = 1.4
for _, item in ipairs(Config.Items) do item.Size = item.Size or Config.BaseSize end

-- MUTATIONS (2026-10-01): every rolled shovel can come out mutated (independent rolls, see RNGHandler).
--   Giant: size 2 (normal shovels are 1.4), 5x rarer.  Shiny: 3x power, 10x rarer.  Both: "Shiny Giant", 50x rarer.
-- Variants live in Config.ByName and Config.VariantsOf[base] but NOT in Config.Items, so the roll table and Index stay 35 shovels.
local Balance = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Balance"))
Config.Mutations = {
	{Id = "Shiny", Chance = 10, PowerMult = 3, SizeMult = 1},
	{Id = "Giant", Chance = 5,  PowerMult = 1, SizeMult = 2 / Config.BaseSize}, -- keeps a Giant at size 2
}
Config.MutationById = {}
for _, m in ipairs(Config.Mutations) do Config.MutationById[m.Id] = m end
function Config.VariantName(baseName, ids)
	local has, prefix = {}, ""
	for _, id in ipairs(ids or {}) do has[id] = true end
	for _, m in ipairs(Config.Mutations) do if has[m.Id] then prefix ..= m.Id .. " " end end
	return prefix .. baseName
end
local function rarityFor(chance, fallback)
	local best, bestMin = fallback, -1
	for name, minC in pairs(Config.RarityMinChance or {}) do
		if chance >= minC and minC > bestMin and Config.Rarities and Config.Rarities[name] then best, bestMin = name, minC end
	end
	return best
end
Config.VariantsOf = {}
for _, base in ipairs(Config.Items) do
	local basePower = base.Power or Balance.ShovelPower(base.Chance)
	local list = {}
	for _, combo in ipairs({{"Giant"}, {"Shiny"}, {"Shiny", "Giant"}}) do
		local v = table.clone(base)
		local chance, power, size = 1, 1, base.Size or 1
		for _, id in ipairs(combo) do
			local m = Config.MutationById[id]
			chance *= m.Chance; power *= m.PowerMult; size *= m.SizeMult
		end
		v.Name = Config.VariantName(base.Name, combo)
		v.Base = base.Name
		v.Mutations = combo
		v.Mutation = table.concat(combo, " ")
		v.Chance = base.Chance * chance
		v.Rarity = rarityFor(v.Chance, base.Rarity)
		v.Power = math.max(1, math.floor(basePower * power))
		v.Size = size
		Config.ByName[v.Name] = v
		table.insert(list, v)
	end
	Config.VariantsOf[base.Name] = list
end

return Config
